dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Ragdoll definitely continues to show how much of a doll she actually is. She's such an affectionate dog who loves her tubby rubbed at all times! She will always try to seek your attention for head pats & to make sure you remember she's still there. Once she's very comfortable with you, she will not want to leave your side and will wait for you on the other side of the door. However, she's definitely part husky and will voice her opinion when she deems it's the right time. She's lovable, friendly & enjoys her playtime to the fullest extent.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.

I am looking for a home with a patient person.

Please check here for updated adoption hours.
dog.name: Ragdoll
